settings.manual_import_root_path.label: Manual import root
settings.manual_import_root_path.descrip: Directory used to browse and import local files by hand; for importing existing media.
settings.base_url.label: qBittorrent address
settings.base_url.description: qBittorrent WebUI address; the backend uses it for connection tests and download submissions.
settings.username.label: Username
settings.password.label: Password
settings.password.description: qBittorrent WebUI login password; leave empty while editing to keep the saved password.
settings.remote_save_root.label: qBittorrent save root
settings.remote_save_root.description: Download root as seen by the qBittorrent process, e.g. /downloads.
settings.backend_import_root_path.label: Backend download root
settings.backend_import_root_path.descri: The same download root as seen by the backend process; it must map to the same host directory as the qBittorrent path.
